import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit import Model, Parameters
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, PolynomialModel
df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\WINDOWS\TEMP\ramanlens-eval\v3-id-devhard-haiku\bare\syn-graphene-02\spectrum.csv")
x = df.shift_cm1.values; y = df.intensity.values

def run(lo, hi, centers, label, deg=2, extra_bands=()):
    m = (x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    mod = PolynomialModel(degree=deg, prefix='b_')
    pars = mod.make_params()
    pars['b_c0'].set(value=np.percentile(yy,20))
    for k in range(1,deg+1): pars[f'b_c{k}'].set(value=0.0)
    for i,(c,amp,w) in enumerate(centers):
        L = LorentzianModel(prefix=f'p{i}_')
        mod = mod + L
        pars.update(L.make_params())
        pars[f'p{i}_center'].set(value=c, min=c-25, max=c+25)
        pars[f'p{i}_amplitude'].set(value=amp, min=0)
        pars[f'p{i}_sigma'].set(value=w, min=2, max=80)
    res = mod.fit(yy, pars, x=xx)
    print(f"== {label}  window {lo}-{hi}  chi2red={res.redchi:.1f}  n={len(xx)}")
    for i in range(len(centers)):
        c=res.params[f'p{i}_center']; s=res.params[f'p{i}_sigma']; a=res.params[f'p{i}_amplitude']
        fwhm=2*s.value; height=a.value*2/(np.pi*fwhm)  # Lorentzian peak height above baseline
